metadata_rules: machineType accelerators describes attached accelerator type/count; do not fabricate an attachment extra
GPU vendor/model/VRAM and driver-ready image require trusted explicit facts, not machine-name guesses
actual immutable image diskSizeGb is a boot-volume minimum
exact provisioned disk and VM limits must satisfy requested performance; missing facts remain unknown
fixed zonal offer cannot use a child config whose regional placement can select another zone
pricing_rules: preserve fractional GiB and unitPrice units+nanos exactly
displayQuantity does not divide or multiply actual unit price
do not double-count CPU/RAM/GPU when a selected billing product already bundles them
math-only GPU/license fixture is not a claim that an unsupported child launch is eligible
